Agent block.description: Front matter for an agent-readable post: summary, audience, a claim with evidence, a source and a next step. Every field is optional.
body: summary: "${1:The post's thesis in one sentence.}"
not_for: ["${4:Who it does not apply to}"]
prerequisites: ["${5:What the reader needs to know}"]
author_experience: "${6:What you have done hands-on that this post draws on.}"
- { action: "${14:What the reader should do next}", link: "${15:#heading}" }

Agent claim.description: One claim with its evidence, for agent.claims.
body: evidence: { type: ${3|measured,experienced,cited,opinion|}, detail: "${4:How you know.}", link: "${5:#heading}" }$0

Agent source.description: One source the post relies on or responds to, for agent.sources.

Site settings.description: Site-wide settings for _quarto.yml. Every field is optional.

Disable on this page.description: Front matter that turns the WebMCP tools off on one page.
